study_design: Single-center, randomized, open-label trial with blinded outcome adjudication; modified intention-to-treat analysis
outcome_definition: Serum-creatinine-only AKI meeting at least one stage 1 criterion from any of three creatinine-based definitions: AKIN, RIFLE, or KDIGO. Urine output was not used.
source_location: Pages 3-4, Study Outcomes and Primary Outcomes sections; page 7, Table 2

study_label: Snel et al randomized pilot study
study_design: Single-center, open-label, phase IV randomized controlled pilot study; intention-to-treat analysis
outcome_definition: Any-stage AKI based exclusively on the serum-creatinine component of KDIGO 2012: stage 1, serum creatinine increase ≥0.3 mg/dL within 48 hours or ≥1.5 times baseline within 7 days; stage 2, 2.0-2.9 times baseline; stage 3, 3.0 times baseline, serum creatinine ≥4.0 mg/dL, or initiation of renal replacement therapy.
extraction_note: Empagliflozin versus standard care. Supplementary Table 3 explicitly separates creatinine-defined AKI from urine-output-defined and combined KDIGO AKI; the 'Creatinine—Any' row was selected.

study_design: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial; intention-to-treat analysis
outcome_definition: AKI defined exclusively by KDIGO serum-creatinine criteria, excluding urine-output criteria.
extraction_note: Dapagliflozin versus placebo. The article explicitly reports the post hoc creatinine-only AKI counts and RR (0.93, 95% CI 0.66-1.32); raw randomized arm-level data were selected for pooling.
